'''Mag''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Galactic Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He sold schematics to make gear on [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="TOR" />
